title: Hi, I'm <name>Mónica Calle.</name>
p1: I'm a product designer (UX/UI) with a foundation in front-end development. I research, prototype in high fidelity, and refine the usability and conversion of real products, bringing together visual sensitivity, strategic thinking and technical judgment so every decision has intention and adds value.
p2: I came to design through front-end, so I validate technical feasibility before development and check that what's built matches the design. That bridge between design and development lets me follow every project from the first idea to its execution, with considered, intuitive and solid interfaces.
p3: I enjoy turning ideas into digital products that connect with people, solve real needs and leave a memorable impression.
